grants.description: Verify your identity as a registered attorney on the LPA
grants.purpose: To confirm you are a registered attorney with authority to notify OPG of the donor's death

grants.description: Share the donor's death certificate with OPG
grants.purpose: To confirm the donor has passed away and the LPA must be cancelled

grants.description: Return the original LPA document and certified copies to OPG
grants.purpose: OPG must receive the original LPA document to cancel it. The LPA will be destroyed unless you request its return.

grants.description: Provide a return address if you want the cancelled LPA sent back instead of destroyed
grants.purpose: To return the cancelled LPA document to you rather than destroying it

revocation.mechanism: Contact OPG by phone or post before documents are sent
revocation.effect: Notification will be cancelled. You will remain responsible for notifying OPG of the donor's death.

delegation.limitations: Agent cannot physically send the original LPA document on your behalf. Agent cannot decide whether the LPA should be destroyed or returned. Agent cannot act if you are not a registered attorney on the LPA.
